test_title: PYST 33: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Two banks, A and B, offered loans at 3.5% and 7.5% per annum, respectively. Atul borrowed an amount of ₹2,20,000 from each bank. Find the positive difference (in ₹) between the amounts of simple interest paid to the two banks by Atul after 3 years.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Rate difference = 7.5% − 3.5% = 4% per annum.

Total interest percentage difference for 3 years = 4% × 3 = 12%.

Required difference = 12% of Principal = 12/100 × 2,20,000.

Required difference = 12 × 2,200 = 26,400.

**∴ The correct answer is 26,400.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2,20,000

Rate 1 (R₁) = 3.5% | Rate 2 (R₂) = 7.5%

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b12743ee9a4c5496979b0fef82ab6b91f16dbc701f7b844a3ae1a6e0fd8d0ef.png] 

⇒ SI paid to Bank A = (2,20,000 × 3.5 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ SI paid to Bank A = 2,200 × 10.5 = 23,100

⇒ SI paid to Bank B = (2,20,000 × 7.5 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ SI paid to Bank B = 2,200 × 22.5 = 49,500

⇒ Positive Difference = SI paid to Bank B − SI paid to Bank A

⇒ Positive Difference = 49,500 − 23,100

⇒ Positive Difference = 26,400

**∴ The correct answer is 26,400.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Concept

Simple interest is calculated only on the initial principal amount. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Interest Difference Rule

When Principal and Time are constant, the difference in SI is proportional to the difference in rates: ΔSI = P × ΔR × T ÷ 100.

Amount Calculation

The total amount (A) payable after time T is the sum of Principal and Simple Interest: A = P + SI.
